name: Corydon (United States)
description: Horizontal tricolour of pale yellow, dark blue and pale yellow, the blue bearing CORYDON and Est. 1808 in yellow, with an outline map of Indiana across the stripes bearing the town hall and a dot for Corydon.
history: Corydon is the county seat of Harrison County, Indiana, and was the second capital of Indiana Territory and the first state capital. Flags of the World describes the flag from one purchased at the town hall in 2024.

features.role: outline map of Indiana with the town hall and a dot for Corydon
